name: MedBridge synthetic PII/PHI redaction test set - blind held-out v2
description: Fully synthetic patient-style messages (Indian, US and UK contexts; casual, formal, Hinglish and SMS-style with typos) mixed with clinical content. All names, numbers and addresses are invented. Authored BLIND: the author did not read the redaction detector (medbridge/privacy/redaction.py), its evaluation script (scripts/pii_eval.py) or its reported metrics; only the schema of pii_testset.json (conventions plus its first 3 records) was inspected. Never used for tuning. Includes hard negatives (drug brand names, festival/weekday names, capitalised common nouns, dates of readings, PIN-like lab values) and out-of-scope positives (names with no introduction cue) so recall and precision are not overstated.

authoring_protocol.synthetic_identifiers: Aadhaar numbers carry a valid Verhoeff check digit; NHS numbers are in the 999 test range with a valid mod-11 check digit; US phone numbers use 555-01xx; UK phone numbers use Ofcom drama ranges (07700 900xxx, 020 7946 0xxx); other ids are random strings in realistic formats

conventions.NAME: person-name tokens only; titles (Mr./Dr./Mrs.), honorifics (ji) and cue words excluded; possessive 's excluded
conventions.PHONE: full number incl. country code / trunk prefix and internal separators; label excluded
conventions.IP: IPv4 / IPv6 address (an IP inside a URL counts as URL only)
conventions.AADHAAR|PAN|SSN|MRN|INSURANCE_ID: identifier value only, label excluded; MRN also covers UHID, ABHA, CR/IP numbers and NHS numbers
conventions.ADDRESS: from the house/flat cue or house number through street, locality, city and state; PIN/ZIP excluded; a UK postcode is not a PIN/ZIP and stays inside ADDRESS
conventions.PINCODE: 6-digit Indian PIN or US ZIP (ZIP+4 kept whole) value only
conventions.AGE: the exact date-of-birth expression only (replaced by [AGE: N]); year-only mentions are not redacted
conventions.protected: substrings that must survive redaction unchanged (clinical values, drug names, doses, ages)
conventions.negatives: kind=negative examples contain no PII; the redacted text must equal the input exactly
conventions.start/end: added in v2: 0-based character offsets into text (end exclusive); text[start:end] == span text

splits.heldout: blind v2: authored without access to the detector, its eval script or its metrics; never used for tuning
